summary: Pull out the scalar of D.restrictToY and bound the branching matrix; the sizes are controlled by the data.

steps.claim: For each τ, log|τ(π)| + log|τ(π̄)| = log N (ππ̄ = N).
steps.lean: have k (τ : D.Φ) := congr(‖weightEmbedding σ τ $D.π_mul_star‖.log)

steps.claim: The scalar ∏_τ τ(π̄)^{−D.branchExp τ} of D.restrictToY comes out of the Weyl norm (squared).
Bound the branching matrix by its size bound (D.branching) as an exponential of a sum of n_m·h terms.

grw [D.branching.2.2.1 _ (sum_mono fun _ ↦ (sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ (D.n D.m * D.h) ?_).trans

all_goals simp_all [Real.log_prod, Real.log_mul, @starRingEnd_apply D.E,
    sum_mul, mul_sum, mul_left_comm (2 : ℝ), card_congr D.lastIndexEquiv, prod_eq_zero_iff, -not_or]
